name: contract-recorded-cases
goal: Normal verification retains hashed per-case observations and rejects missing or malformed execution coverage

evidence: CheckRunService retains aggregate runner status and browser diagnostics but discards per-case outcomes. A process exit alone does not prove registered cases ran.

Strengthen existing success/failure CheckRunService.run fixture cases to retain exact case observations, revision and immutable raw evidence hash; preserve all four existing cases and diagnostics boundaries.
